text:
clara: heads-up, onboarding GemmaX -> Llama-sim produced a long-context degradation after nf4 quant + rotary-perm adapter. short prompts look fine, anything >1500 tokens starts echoing short phrases (comma/and fragments).
devon: can you paste the exact convert + quant commands and the tokenizer/vocab meta used?
clara: pipeline: gemmax.ckpt -> hf -> llama-sim adapter. used "rotary-permute=pack24" adapter and quantize_nf4 with default calib (web-short). commands:
```
python hf_export.py --in ckpts/gemmax --out /tmp/gemmax_hf --tokenizer gemmax_token.json
python llama_adapter.py --hf /tmp/gemmax_hf --out /tmp/llamasim --rotary-permute pack24 --vocab-meta maps/vocab_sentinel_v2.json
python quantize_nf4.py --model /tmp/llamasim --calib datasets/web-short --out /tmp/llamasim-nf4
```
clara: short->hosted parity ok, long->looping fragments after ~1200 tokens.
sahil: interesting combo: rotary permutation + short calibration set. two quick thoeries: 1) calib stats biased on short contexts make quant scale/zero-point off for long ctx activations; 2) the "pack24" head packing permutes head order so our runtime kv-index mapping may be misaligned with converter's permute spec. either can cause attention to preferentially pull a small set of kv slots.
devon: do you have a minimal token trace + logits around first repeat?
clara: paste below (small snippet):
```
# token ids & text around loop
[3001, 77, 11, 3001, 77, 11, 3001] -> [",", "and", "then", ",", "and", "then"]
# probs pre -> loop
pre: top1=0.06 entropy=3.8
loop_start: top1=0.82 entropy=0.65
```
infra-bot: job:quantize-nf4 started id=job-9812
sahil: that entropy collapse + repeating punctuation makes me suspect kv-key aliasing (token id -> kv slot mismatch) rather than pure quant noise. does maps/vocab_sentinel_v2.json include any sentinel remapping or token_id_offset?
clara: yes snippet: {"sentinel_offset": 2, "aliases": [[0,2],[1,3]]} (i.e., some token ids shifted for sentinel layout).
devon: sentinel_offset + pack24 permutation = bad combo. converter expects final token ids contiguous; runtime assumes packed head order for kv index calculation. if sentinel_offset wasn't folded into kv-key generation, keys will point to wrong memory slots.
sahil: triage plan:
- reproduce deterministically with seed fixed and a 3k token alternating probe
- re-run quant with a longctx calibration set (datasets/longcal) to rule out calib bias
- run adapter with rotary-permute=none (no pack) to see if permute is culprit
- temporary runtime shim: KV_SLOT_BASE_OFFSET and ROTARY_PERM_ORDER envs so we can test quick fixes without re-export

clara: running deterministic probe now with seed=42. starting three runs: 1) longcal + same adapter; 2) web-short + adapter but runtime KV_SLOT_BASE_OFFSET=2; 3) web-short + adapter with ROTARY_PERM_ORDER=identity.
eval-bot: run_id=ev-176888-1
```
bench: longctx-stability
model: gemmax->llamasim-nf4
metrics:
  ppl_1k: "12.0"
  ppl_3k: "56.0"
  repeat_rate_2k+: "0.52"
```
clara: early results: run(1) longcal -> ppl_3k drops to 18.7 and repeat_rate to 0.08. run(2) KV_SLOT_BASE_OFFSET=2 -> repeat_rate 0.12, ppl_3k 22.9. run(3) ROTARY_PERM_ORDER=identity -> repeat_rate 0.07, ppl_3k 17.5.
devon: both fixes help but perm order toggle looks strongest. suggests both perm and calib contribute. perm issue probably explains the exact repeating token ids. quant calib made it worse but not sole cause.
sahil: actionable items:
- add export-time normalizer that folds sentinel_offset into final token ids (converter should emit normalized vocab with sentinel_offset=0)
- add unit test encoding a 4-token alternating probe for 3k tokens to export pipeline
- runtime: add env flags KV_SLOT_BASE_OFFSET and ROTARY_PERM_ORDER for emergency shims
- re-run full eval suite comparing hosted GemmaX and exported Llama-sim after applying export normalization + longctx calibration

clara: creating a tiny repro gist and adding logs to triage board. will open PR for converter normalizer and a small test. pinging @devon to add the runtime flag PR.
devon: on it, will draft small change and include debug mapping logs when repeat detected.
clara: thanks all, will follow up with full eval after PRs land. :thumbsup!
